verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an official developer build surface but never names an SDK library. That surface includes an app quickstart where plugins expose capabilities through MCP servers, the open MCP Apps UI standard, a Checkout API reference, and a documented plugin.json manifest schema scaffolded by `@plugin-creator`. Building against official protocols and schemas covers only a thin part of a story about official SDKs. missing for 10: any explicitly named official SDK (e.g., language client libraries for building plugins or apps), SDK reference docs and install instructions, versioning or language coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK-based development.
